truth_definitions.linear_k: first len(predicted_steps) descendants in global sequence_index order
truth_definitions.chain_k: the walked unique-successor chain of len(predicted_steps) (strict-chain anchors only)
truth_definitions.layers_h: all descendants within H successor layers (workload coverage)

meta.primary_population: primary_strict_chain_gpu (unique single-successor chain for K steps, anchor lane gpu)

definitions.shat_tau: sum of predicted runtime_ms_quantiles[tau] over the artifact scenario-0 steps (0 allowed)
definitions.extra_load_p95: load_duration_ms_quantiles.p95 summed over steps with load_occurrence_probability >= 0.5
definitions.bootstrap_cluster: video_id taken from the template record

data_facts.j_series_dataset_disjoint: 0/640 run-id overlap and 0/160 video overlap with the R7 workload
data_facts.excluded_workflow_roots: 640 ':run:1' pseudo-events have no schedulable template node

wording_guards.linear_k: chain-compatible anchors only: summed predicted quantiles vs measured runtime over an equal-cardinality realized continuation
wording_guards.layers_h_and_all: workload-coverage comparisons that jointly reflect structural omission and resource-estimation error; not pure runtime calibration
